name: wincontrol
description: A Winamp-skinned controller for whatever is playing on your Mac (Spotify app, Bandcamp tabs, anything in Now Playing). Plays nothing itself - pure remote control.

scripts.helpers: clang -fobjc-arc -O2 -o helper/balance helper/balance.c -framework CoreFoundation -framework CoreAudio && clang -fobjc-arc -O2 -o helper/eqtap helper/eqtap.m -framework Foundation -framework CoreAudio

extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: WinControl taps system audio output to apply the equalizer.
